businesses.business: consumer credit reporting and information services

offering_description.value: Provides credit reporting, risk and fraud analytics, identity verification, and marketing data to lenders, insurers, retailers, telecoms and other businesses, and credit monitoring to consumers. It builds products from large consumer data assets and delivers them through data feeds, APIs and software platforms.

primary_products.value: credit reports and scores; risk and fraud analytics software; identity verification solutions; marketing and audience data; consumer credit monitoring subscriptions

primary_services.value: credit reporting; fraud and identity verification; consumer credit monitoring; analytics and consulting; marketing data services

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, lenders, insurers, retailers, telecoms, healthcare providers, landlords, marketers; B2C: consumers buying credit reports, scores and monitoring; B2G: government agencies using identity and fraud solutions

end_markets.value: financial services; insurance; healthcare; telecommunications; retail; government

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: per-inquiry fees for credit reports, scores and verification queries; subscription: consumer credit monitoring and business platform subscriptions; service fees: analytics, consulting and marketing data services
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: aggregates consumer data from lenders and others, sells analytics and platforms to businesses; service provider: credit bureau services sold to businesses and consumers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Latin America, Africa, India, UK and Asia Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: credit reporting, fraud and identity, marketing solutions and consumer services built on shared data

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving lenders, insurers and enterprise accounts; online: direct-to-consumer website and app for credit monitoring; partners / resellers: resellers and integration partners using APIs

regulatory_exposure.value: high: consumer reporting agency regulated under FCRA, CFPB, FTC, and data privacy laws such as GDPR and GLBA
